prose: Simon Willison released llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0, a plugin for OpenAI's new Decisions API, announced at DevDay. He had GPT-6 Astra read the docs and build it, modelled on his llm-typesafe plugin for a similar API. The new gpt-6-luna decision model accepts images as well as text, and costs 10 cents per million input tokens against 4.2 cents for the rival. Both offer yes/no, choice and score questions. His example asks whether an image contains mammals and returns a probability.
highlights: Plugin for OpenAI's Decisions API, built by GPT-6 Astra.
gpt-6-luna accepts images; 10 cents per million input tokens.
Three question types: predicate, choice, score.
